name: ws-p4-nano
title: Waveshare ESP32-P4-NANO
notes: ESP32-P4NRW32 (32 MB PSRAM), 16 MB flash (GD25Q128); the ESP32-C6 companion isn't used. IP101GRI on the chip's MAC with IDF's P4 defaults (MDC 31, MDIO 52, REF_CLK in on GPIO50), PHY reset on GPIO51, address 1. Pins: Waveshare wiki and schematic, ESPHome devices page, arduino-esp32 waveshare_p4_poe_eth variant. microSD on SDMMC slot 0 (CLK 43, CMD 44, D0-D3 39-42), IO bank on LDO channel 4; the card's supply switch on GPIO45 is on by default. Optional PoE module header. Early units carry silicon v1.x. Power LED only: no LED the firmware can drive.
